title: Correlate Pane Sequencer — Request Drilldown & Span Sequencing Prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, focus+context Correlate Pane that lets engineers go from an observed anomaly in the Console dashboard to a time-aligned, span-sequenced view of a single request session. The pane lives as a slide-over from Dashboards and from Rollouts/Errors rows; it should show: a compact timeline of spans with relative durations, highlight correlation IDs across services, an event ridge/mini-heatmap for async wakes, request metadata (model, route, tokens, cost estimate), quick filters (service, span-kind, status, tag search), and deep-links to full Trace Canvas and Session Replay. Prototype must explore density modes (compact / expanded), keyboard-first navigation, and a contextual actions menu (annotate, pin, start eval, create rollback request). The design must balance information density for quick Triage while keeping path to full investigation obvious.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype Figma screens for Compact and Expanded Correlate Pane, including timeline, span list, and metadata header
Interactive prototype (InVision/Figma) shows keyboard navigation: focus next/prev span, open span details (enter), and copy correlation ID (c)
Filter controls that preserve timeline positions when toggling service/span-kind filters
Design spec includes mobile/responsive fallback for Console narrow widths
Accessibility notes: color contrast, keyboard focus order, ARIA labels for timeline and span rows
Handoff doc with component tokens, spacing, microcopy for annotations, and 3 example drilldown flows (failed request, high-cost tail, rollout-variant mismatch)
Stakeholder review signoffs from PM (Kara Li), Eng lead (Ravi Shah), and SRE (Jordan Liu)
comments: 2025-01-10 Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created. Goal is to give on-call engineers a compact investigatory surface that reduces time-to-insight from Dashboard. Attached three example incidents and a short PRD. Blocking questions: should cost estimate be token-based only or include inferred infra cost?

2025-01-14 Mateo Alvarez: Spoke with Eng infra (Ravi). Recommended expose token cost + relative percentile (eg. 92nd) rather than absolute infra dollars for now. Also suggested we cap span rows in Compact mode to 8 and allow 'show more'.

2025-01-20 Design-review: Figma first pass posted. Key feedback from Kara (PM): add explicit 'rollout variant' badge in header when request originates from canary. Jordan (SRE) asked for a toggle to overlay 'slow spans' band on timeline. Added to next iteration.

2025-01-23 Accessibility audit (internal): Contrast on green success badge fails on small text. Updated token colors and added focus ring in prototype. Also added aria-describedby on correlation ID copy button.

2025-01-28 Engineering feasibility review: Eng flagged that live KV cache timeline may be expensive to compute for large trace windows. Decided to provide sampled timeline for pane (last 200 spans) with link to full Trace Canvas for complete data. Added note to spec about server-side summarization endpoint (trace/sample-summary).

2025-01-31 Prototype demo: Walked PM/Eng/SRE through keyboard flows. Received request to add 'create eval from span' shortcut (E). Added as anchor action in the contextual menu. Recorded demo: https://meetings.redwood-inference.com/recordings/2025-01-31-correlate-pane

2025-02-04 UX critique: Reduce horizontal padding on span rows to allow longer span names on compact view. Replaced multi-line span labels with tooltip-on-hover to preserve vertical rhythm. Mateo to update prototype and push to handoff.

2025-02-06 Mateo Alvarez: Updated Figma and pushed Handoff doc to Drive. Engineering tickets created: ENG-21455 (API: trace/sample-summary), ENG-21478 (Console: correlate-pane UI components). Marking ticket for design review meeting on 2025-02-08.
notes: Trade-offs: We chose sampled timeline vs. full trace for performance; this reduces immediate fidelity but preserves console responsiveness. Future phase should add on-demand full-trace expansion. Also keeping monetary cost out of the first pass favors privacy and avoids billing integration complexity.
next_steps: 1) Design review 2025-02-08 signoff. 2) Finalize component spec and tokens. 3) Support Eng in API contract for trace/sample-summary. 4) Track follow-up tickets for Rollout badges + Eval flow.
